reasons: Rule kind is 'missing' and the cited Article XXI (Effect of Termination) is entirely one-directional (Licensee returns Licensor materials within five days and certifies); nothing in the quoted text or definitions provides transition assistance, data export, deletion or certification obligations on Licensor, so the 'missing' classification is supported.

The insertion is placed correctly in the termination article as a new subsection (c) and tracks the preferred position: six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, thirty-day return of Licensee Data in a commonly used machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter.

Original paragraph text is left intact — the edit is purely additive and is the smallest change that reaches the playbook position; the short definition of 'Licensee Data' and the survival/no-withholding sentence are reasonable, necessary scaffolding rather than unrelated expansion.

Comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural with the required prefix, explains what changed and why, and offers the ninety-day fallback while preserving the thirty-day export and deletion certificate.
Deterministic checks both pass and are consistent with the substance of the redline.
